notes.subject: car
notes.text: All coverage is low-quality camera, dimmer and hazier than the older version in India and Nigeria; the car is often fully blurred, bigger blur at the back.

notes.subject: language
notes.text: The main language is the one of the former colonial power in southwest Europe.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: Ladder-style poles and pedestrian signs copy the designs used in the former colonial power.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Tropical islands almost completely covered in rainforest, with banana plants everywhere.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: A slanted antenna sticks out from the side of the car in many spots.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: Some wooden poles are painted blue at the bottom and carry the letters CST.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Taxis and minibuses are painted bright yellow.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: An even dimmer, desaturated version of the low-quality camera is most common on the smaller island, whose car has a blue roof and silver roof rails.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: The car on the bigger island is black with black roof rails and is usually blurred out.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Oil palm plantations are found in the south of the main island.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: The town of Trindade has poles painted red and white.
